column1: # PB-RUN-1 -- the supported Android version matrix. One row per API level the app claims to
# support, so the claim is contiguous and its endpoints are checkable rather than implied.
# The floor is ADR-007 B16's: Curve25519 entered KeyMint only in Android 13 (API 33), and
# below it the NoiseStatic/Recipient roles cannot be Keystore-native, which would silently
# degrade PB-KEY-8's central property on old devices. 33 makes PB-KEY-8 clean by construction
# instead of forcing a fallback matrix nobody exercises.
# The target is 36, raised from 35 on 2026-08-02. Play's own requirements page sets a HARD
# DATE: from 2026-08-31 a new app cannot be SUBMITTED unless it targets 36, and the closed
# testing track this beta ships on is not exempt. Bumping ahead of the date rather than at
# upload time is the whole reason: discovering it at upload means re-running the Kotlin lane
# under a deadline.
# WHAT TARGETING 36 OPTS INTO, checked one by one against developer.android.com/about/versions
# /16/behavior-changes-16 rather than assumed:
#  - Edge-to-edge is no longer opt-out-able (R.attr#windowOptOutEdgeToEdgeEnforcement is
#    disabled at 36). This app never set that attribute and has been laid out edge-to-edge
#    since 35 anyway; PhoneActivity.insetTheSystemBars already pads the root by the real
#    WindowInsets.Type.systemBars, which is ADR-007 B132's fix. Nothing to do.
#  - Predictive back is on by default and onBackPressed() is no longer called. The app never
#    overrode onBackPressed(): PhoneActivity registers an androidx OnBackPressedCallback, which
#    the framework drives through OnBackInvokedDispatcher on either side of the change.
#  - Orientation, resizability and aspect-ratio restrictions are ignored at sw600dp. The
#    manifest declares no screenOrientation, no resizableActivity and no aspect ratio, so
#    there is nothing for the platform to ignore.
#  - Foreground-service and JobScheduler quota changes have no subject here: no <service> holds
#    a foregroundServiceType (ADR-007 B16 disconnects on backgrounding) and the app schedules
#    no job.
#  - Nothing at 36 touches KeyMint, KeyGenParameterSpec, StrongBox or attestation. Android 16's
#    only Keystore-adjacent change is mandatory RKP for devices LAUNCHING with 16, which is a
#    device provisioning policy and not targetSdk-gated; keys/Provisioning.kt requests no
#    attestation challenge. This mattered because that path fails closed on first launch.
# API 36.1 (the QPR2 minor SDK) is deliberately NOT the target: Google states a minor SDK
# version "cannot introduce targetSdkVersion gated behavior changes", so it would buy nothing
# and cost a second platform install.
# compileSdk moves with it, and not only because AGP refuses a targetSdk above compileSdk --
# the app cannot opt into behaviour it cannot compile against.
# Note that none of these is gomobile's -androidapi, which is the NDK's floor (21) and a
# different decision; see SWARM_ANDROID_API in android/toolchain.env.
# Columns, tab-separated: api, Android release, role (min | supported | target).
